formattedAddress: 110, Taiwan, Taipei City, Xinyi District, Xingya Village, Songren Rd, 28號B2F

displayName.text: 成真咖啡 台北信義寶麗廣場店

text.text:
Srsly the perfect cafe with the perfect pancakes and the perfect staffs.

everyone’s so attentive and so chill, pancakes are the best I’ve had ever, food is made on site upon order, and they’re always warm when served, not pipping hot so you don’t get burnt. So many attention to details, 10/10

Also the cafe donates 50% of their profit to clean water projects in Africa, i have to pay respects to this noble act🫡.
